mapper.sql: (JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(content,'$**.mediaId'),JSON_QUOTE(#{mediaId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(content,'$**.resourceId'),JSON_QUOTE(#{mediaId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(content,'$**.sourceMediaId'),JSON_QUOTE(#{mediaId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(content,'$**.mediaIds'),JSON_QUOTE(#{mediaId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(content,'one',CONCAT('$.inputMediaVersions."',#{mediaId},'"')) OR JSON_SEARCH(content,'one',CONCAT('%media://',#{mediaId},'%')) IS NOT NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT anchor_kind AS kind, anchor_id AS id, canvas_id AS canvasId, retention_class AS retention FROM afv_media_all_reference_document WHERE UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSINESS_BINDING', CONCAT(resource_type,':',resource_id,':',field_name), NULL, 'LIVE' FROM afv_media_binding WHERE media_id=#{mediaId} UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSINESS_SOURCE', CONCAT(source_type,':',source_id,':',source_version,':',source_field), NULL, 'HISTORY' FROM afv_media_source WHERE resource_id=#{mediaId} UNION ALL SELECT 'PRESET', preset_key, NULL, 'LIVE' FROM afv_media_preset_binding WHERE media_id=#{mediaId} UNION ALL SELECT 'AUDIO_GENERATION_TASK_OUTPUT',t.id,NULL,'HISTORY' FROM afv_media_resource m JOIN afv_audio_generation_task t ON m.created_by=t.user_id AND m.request_id LIKE CONCAT(t.id,'-audio-%') WHERE m.id=#{mediaId} ORDER BY kind, id

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT input_json AS content FROM afv_remote_generation_job WHERE state NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED','CANCELLED') UNION ALL SELECT JSON_ARRAY(input_json,checkpoint_json) FROM afv_media_job WHERE status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING') UNION ALL SELECT JSON_ARRAY(input_json,result_json) FROM afv_audio_generation_task WHERE state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','INGESTING') AND deleted=FALSE UNION ALL SELECT snapshot_json FROM afv_canvas_run WHERE status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED','BLOCKED','CANCELLED') ) active_documents WHERE ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM afv_media_resource m JOIN afv_audio_generation_task t ON m.created_by=t.user_id AND m.request_id LIKE CONCAT(t.id,'-audio-%') WHERE m.id=#{mediaId} AND t.state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','INGESTING') AND t.deleted=FALSE ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM afv_media_access_ticket WHERE resource_id=#{mediaId} AND purpose<>'BROWSER' AND revoked=FALSE AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM afv_media_preview_job p JOIN afv_media_job j ON j.id=p.job_id WHERE p.source_resource_id=#{mediaId} AND j.status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING') )
SELECT output_resource_id FROM afv_media_preview_job WHERE source_resource_id=#{mediaId} AND output_resource_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY output_resource_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_media_resource WHERE blob_id=#{blobId} AND id<>#{mediaId} AND state IN ('READY','STAGING')
